periods.label: Wed 23 Sep
periods.text: Northeasterly 15 to 20 knots. Around 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres offshore. Southerly 1 to 1.5 metres inshore, increasing to 1.5 to 2 metres offshore.
